shared_elements: low relief carving on a stone surface
repeated units arranged in ordered rows/registers
justification: A shows a narrative procession of human figures in profile leading horned rams, framed above and below by bands of rosettes, while B shows a monument covered in dense grids of blocky non-figural glyph-like units with no discernible figures or animals. The only correspondence is the very generic one of orderly repeated units in low relief; the depicted subject matter (living procession vs. abstract sign-blocks) has nothing specific in common.
